title: Pirates!

image.note: nostalgia crack; sha1 of the D64

note: Addresses, raster lines, clocks and counts only; no game code, graphics, map or text bytes. Claims marked [C] in SYNTHESIS.txt were checked by the controller against bytes or traces. The copy is cracked; its start-up options menu patched five interpreter table entries ($31/$32/$33/$36/$39), so opcode meanings for those entries describe the modified copy. Evidence files stay on the maintainer's machine (data/re/pirates/).

observations.what: one raster IRQ per PAL frame, handler $9681 via $0314; fires at raster line 0
observations.source: duel findings section 2.2; sailing findings section 2.9

observations.what: IRQ handler cost 333 cycles entry-to-RTI (142 of 143 duel frames); does music, fine-scroll hand-off, one optional sprite, then JMP $EA31
VIC state at duel in_play (clock 213,772,067): bank 3 ($DD00=$C0), screen $CC00 ($D018=$39), charset $E000, multicolour text ($D011=$1B, $D016=$D8), $01=$36 (BASIC ROM hidden)
VIC state at town (clock 398,407,556): same video mode as duel (bank 3, $CC00, $E000, $D018=$39, $D016=$D8); $01=$37 (BASIC ROM visible, town program running)
VIC state at sailing (clock 552,950,245): bank 3, screen $E400 ($D018=$98), charset $E000, multicolour text; $01=$36
memory layout: BASIC $0801-$3B53 (381-line duel program), boot ML $3BA0-$3DDC; k-block $9500, vb $9600, wn $9980; code under BASIC ROM $A000-$BFFF; game DOS + RAM charset under KERNAL $E000-$FFFF
bank-swap trampoline at $9509 saves old $01 into operand of restore at $9524 (STA $9524); restore at $9523 is LDA #saved / STA $01 / CLI / RTS; nesting-safe
BASIC program swapped per phase: duel 381 lines $0801-$3B53 (VARTAB $3DDD); town 817 lines $0801-$847B (VARTAB $85AD)
FRETOP/MEMSIZ high byte set to $8E (142) by line 4 POKE52,142:POKE56,142:CLR; BASIC heap tops at $8E00, protecting all ML above it

interpreter main loop $A486-$A4EB; opcode fetched LDA ($9E),Y at $A4A8; $00-$7F table opcodes dispatched via self-modifying JMP at $A4EF into 128-word table $A300; $80-$BF push channel state; $C0-$FF pop
interpreter timing: 89 passes per frame (duel), 100 passes per frame median (sailing); median 198 cycles per pass (duel), 174 cycles per pass (sailing); no frame sync, runs flat out
observations.source: scene-vm findings section 2.1; sailing findings section 2.9

observations.what: joystick reads in the scene VM: $A64E (fire) and $A65E (directions) both LDY $A408,X / LDA $DC00,Y; duel used pointer read $A728 LDA ($61),Y ($61/$62=$00DC) once per ~332,000 cycles (16.9 frames)
observations.source: scene-vm findings section 1; sailing findings section 2.5; duel findings section 1

observations.what: ship fixed at screen centre: sprites 4 (hi-res) and 5 (multicolour) at hardware x=180, y=144; 16 headings as pointer pair $40+H/$50+H, H=0..15
one step ~102,700 cycles (~5.2 PAL frames): poll input, map redraw ($9BAE), scroll-register apply via dirty byte mp+$0C, sprite updates; world map static 3,048-byte block $C000-$CBE7

scroll register writes: IRQ path $97BE-$97E1 writes $0288/$D018/$D016/$D011 from mp+$0A (fine X), mp+$0B (fine Y), mp+$0C (screen page + dirty); clears dirty byte after write; 898 traced register writes
LOAD vector $0330 hooked to $02C3 (game's own loader at $F006 with KERNAL banked out); stock serial loader used only for initial 'pirates!+' load; 29 subsequent loads through the hook
scene end: ML returns event code in A0; BASIC reads LN=PEEK(A0); ON LN dispatches: 1=ship sighted, 2=food shortage, 3=news, 4=arrival, 5=keep sailing
